-- denied | Realistische Hausverteidigung
-- Full version: Auto stuff + Config + Rainbow Star Crosshair

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local randomName = "denied_" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
local CONFIG_FILE = "denied_haus_config.json"

getgenv().denied = {
    Aimbot = {
        Enabled = false,
        FOV = 110,
        Smooth = 0.42,
        TeamCheck = true,
        FOVVisible = true,
        RainbowFOV = true,
    },
    ESP = {
        Enabled = true,
        Box = true,
        Names = true,
        TeamCheck = true,
        MaxDistance = 450,
        Rainbow = true,
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255),
    },
    Crosshair = {
        Enabled = true,
        Rainbow = true,
        Size = 18,
        Speed = 2.5,
    },
    Misc = {
        Fullbright = false,
        NoFog = true,
        AntiAFK = true,
        AutoReload = true,
        AutoDoors = false,
        AutoClaim = false,
    },
    MenuKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
}

-- Config speichern / laden
local function saveConfig()
    local ok, HttpService = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService") end)
    if not ok then return end
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(getgenv().denied))
    end)
end

local function loadConfig()
    local ok, HttpService = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService") end)
    if not ok then return end
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE) then
            local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FILE))
            for k, v in pairs(data) do
                if getgenv().denied[k] then
                    for k2, v2 in pairs(v) do
                        getgenv().denied[k][k2] = v2
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

loadConfig()

-- ================= GUI =================
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = randomName
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() gui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

local main = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 360)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.5, -180)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 18, 42)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

Instance.new("UIStroke", main).Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 220)
Instance.new("UIStroke", main).Thickness = 2

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 70)
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Text = "  denied  |  Hausverteidigung"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local tabFrame = Instance.new("Frame", main)
tabFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26)
tabFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 34)
tabFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local pages = {}
local function makeTab(name, x)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", tabFrame)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 1, 0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 30, 85)
    b.Text = name
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 180, 255)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    b.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for n, p in pairs(pages) do p.Visible = (n == name) end
        for _, child in ipairs(tabFrame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                child.BackgroundColor3 = child.Text == name and Color3.fromRGB(90, 45, 140) or Color3.fromRGB(55, 30, 85)
            end
        end
    end)
end

makeTab("Aimbot", 0)
makeTab("Visuals", 95)
makeTab("Cross", 190)
makeTab("Misc", 285)
makeTab("Config", 380)

local content = Instance.new("Frame", main)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -68)
content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 64)
content.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 14, 35)
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", content).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function createPage(name)
    local p = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", content)
    p.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    p.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    p.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    p.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 70, 220)
    p.Visible = false
    p.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 320)
    pages[name] = p
    return p
end

local function addToggle(parent, text, y, default, callback)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 24)
    f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, y)
    f.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
    l.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text
    l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
    l.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    l.TextSize = 12
    l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 18)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0.5, -9)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(130, 50, 200) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 30, 70)
    b.Text = default and "ON" or "OFF"
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 10
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)

    local state = default
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        b.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        b.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(130, 50, 200) or Color3.fromRGB(50, 30, 70)
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function addSlider(parent, text, y, min, max, default, callback)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    f.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 36)
    f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, y)
    f.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
    l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
    l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    l.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(default)
    l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)
    l.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    l.TextSize = 12
    l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame", f)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 70)
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame", bar)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 70, 230)
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)

    local sliding = false
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sliding = true end end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sliding = false end end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if sliding and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * rel + 0.5)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            l.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(value)
            callback(value)
        end
    end)
end

local function addButton(parent, text, y, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 28)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, y)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 130)
    b.Text = text
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

local aimPage = createPage("Aimbot")
addToggle(aimPage, "Enabled", 6, getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Enabled, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Enabled = v end)
addToggle(aimPage, "Team Check", 34, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.TeamCheck = v end)
addToggle(aimPage, "FOV Circle", 62, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.FOVVisible = v end)
addToggle(aimPage, "Rainbow FOV", 90, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.RainbowFOV = v end)
addSlider(aimPage, "FOV", 124, 40, 250, 110, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.FOV = v end)
addSlider(aimPage, "Smooth", 166, 15, 80, 42, function(v) getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Smooth = v / 100 end)

addToggle(visPage, "Box", 34, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.ESP.Box = v end)
addToggle(visPage, "Names", 62, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.ESP.Names = v end)
addToggle(visPage, "Team Check", 90, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.ESP.TeamCheck = v end)
addToggle(visPage, "Rainbow ESP", 118, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.ESP.Rainbow = v end)
addSlider(visPage, "Max Distance", 152, 100, 800, 450, function(v) getgenv().denied.ESP.MaxDistance = v end)

local crossPage = createPage("Cross")
addToggle(crossPage, "Star Crosshair", 6, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Enabled = v end)
addToggle(crossPage, "Rainbow", 34, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Rainbow = v end)
addSlider(crossPage, "Size", 68, 8, 40, 18, function(v) getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Size = v end)
addSlider(crossPage, "Spin Speed", 110, 1, 8, 3, function(v) getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Speed = v end)

local miscPage = createPage("Misc")
addToggle(miscPage, "Fullbright", 6, false, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.Fullbright = v end)
addToggle(miscPage, "No Fog", 34, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.NoFog = v end)
addToggle(miscPage, "Anti AFK", 62, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.AntiAFK = v end)
addToggle(miscPage, "Auto Reload", 90, true, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoReload = v end)
addToggle(miscPage, "Auto Doors", 118, false, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoDoors = v end)
addToggle(miscPage, "Auto Claim Rewards", 146, false, function(v) getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoClaim = v end)

local configPage = createPage("Config")
addButton(configPage, "Config speichern", 10, function()
    saveConfig()
    print("[denied] Config gespeichert")
end)
addButton(configPage, "Config laden", 48, function()
    loadConfig()
    print("[denied] Config geladen")
end)

pages["Aimbot"].Visible = true

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp then return end
    if input.KeyCode == getgenv().denied.MenuKey then
        main.Visible = not main.Visible
    end
end)

-- ================= FOV + Star Crosshair =================
local fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
fovCircle.Thickness = 1.2
fovCircle.NumSides = 48
fovCircle.Filled = false
fovCircle.Transparency = 0.5
fovCircle.Visible = true

-- 8-point spinning star (like the image)
local starLines = {}
for i = 1, 8 do
    local line = Drawing.new("Line")
    line.Thickness = 1.6
    line.Visible = false
    starLines[i] = line
end

local hue = 0
local starAngle = 0

-- ================= Helpers =================
local function isAlive(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("Head") and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function isEnemy(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if not getgenv().denied.Aimbot.TeamCheck then return true end
    local myTeam = LocalPlayer.Team
    if not myTeam then return true end
    return plr.Team ~= myTeam
end

local function getClosest()
    local closest, dist = nil, getgenv().denied.Aimbot.FOV
    local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isAlive(plr) and isEnemy(plr) then
            local head = plr.Character.Head
            local pos, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            if on and pos.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
                if d < dist then
                    dist = d
                    closest = head
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local held = false
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then held = true end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)

end)

        VirtualUser:CaptureController()

    end
end)

-- Auto Reload / Doors / Claim (safe pcall)
local lastAuto = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if tick() - lastAuto < 0.8 then return end
    lastAuto = tick()

    pcall(function()
        if getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoReload then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then
                    local remote = tool:FindFirstChild("Reload") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        remote:FireServer()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoDoors then
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (obj.Name:lower():find("door") or obj.ActionText:lower():find("open") or obj.ActionText:lower():find("tür")) then
                    if obj.MaxActivationDistance > 0 then
                        fireproximityprompt(obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if getgenv().denied.Misc.AutoClaim then
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (obj.ActionText:lower():find("claim") or obj.ActionText:lower():find("reward") or obj.ObjectText:lower():find("reward")) then
                    fireproximityprompt(obj)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    hue = (hue + dt * 0.35) % 1
    local rainbow = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

    -- FOV
    fovCircle.Position = mouse
    fovCircle.Radius = getgenv().denied.Aimbot.FOV
    fovCircle.Visible = getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Enabled and getgenv().denied.Aimbot.FOVVisible
    if getgenv().denied.Aimbot.RainbowFOV then
        fovCircle.Color = rainbow
    else
        fovCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255)
    end

    -- Star Crosshair
    if getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Enabled then
        starAngle = starAngle + dt * getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Speed
        local size = getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Size
        local col = getgenv().denied.Crosshair.Rainbow and rainbow or Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255)

        for i = 1, 8 do
            local angle = starAngle + (i - 1) * (math.pi / 4)
            local x2 = mouse.X + math.cos(angle) * size
            local y2 = mouse.Y + math.sin(angle) * size
            starLines[i].From = mouse
            starLines[i].To = Vector2.new(x2, y2)
            starLines[i].Color = col
            starLines[i].Visible = true
        end
    else
        for i = 1, 8 do starLines[i].Visible = false end
    end

    if getgenv().denied.ESP.Rainbow then
        getgenv().denied.ESP.Color = rainbow
    end

    if getgenv().denied.Misc.Fullbright then
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1e6
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end
    if getgenv().denied.Misc.NoFog then
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1e6
    end

    if getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Enabled and held then
        local target = getClosest()
        if target then
            local pos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target.Position)
            local delta = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mouse
            mousemoverel(delta.X * getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Smooth, delta.Y * getgenv().denied.Aimbot.Smooth)
        end
    end
end)

-- ================= ESP =================
local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder", CoreGui)
espFolder.Name = randomName .. "_esp"
local boxes = {}

local function clearESP(plr)
    local old = espFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(plr.UserId))
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    if boxes[plr] then pcall(function() boxes[plr]:Remove() end) boxes[plr] = nil end
end

local function createESP(plr)
    clearESP(plr)
    if not isAlive(plr) or not isEnemy(plr) then return end
    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char.Head

    local holder = Instance.new("Folder", espFolder)
    holder.Name = tostring(plr.UserId)

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Adornee = char
    hl.FillColor = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
    hl.OutlineColor = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.65
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Parent = holder

    if getgenv().denied.ESP.Names then
        local bill = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bill.Adornee = head
        bill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 28)
        bill.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.3, 0)
        bill.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bill.Parent = holder

        local nameL = Instance.new("TextLabel", bill)
        nameL.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        nameL.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameL.Text = plr.DisplayName or plr.Name
        nameL.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 255)
        nameL.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        nameL.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        nameL.TextSize = 12
    end

    if getgenv().denied.ESP.Box then
        local box = Drawing.new("Square")
        box.Thickness = 1.2
        box.Filled = false
        box.Color = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
        boxes[plr] = box
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not getgenv().denied.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, c in ipairs(espFolder:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
        for plr in pairs(boxes) do clearESP(plr) end
        return
    end

    local current = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if not isAlive(plr) or not isEnemy(plr) then
            clearESP(plr)
            continue
        end
        local root = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        local head = plr.Character.Head
        local dist = (root.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > getgenv().denied.ESP.MaxDistance then
            clearESP(plr)
            continue
        end

        current[plr] = true
        if not espFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(plr.UserId)) then
            createESP(plr)
        end

        local holder = espFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(plr.UserId))
        if holder then
            local hl = holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
            if hl then
                hl.FillColor = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
                hl.OutlineColor = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
            end
        end

        if getgenv().denied.ESP.Box and boxes[plr] then
            local top = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
            local bot = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
            if top.Z > 0 and bot.Z > 0 then
                local h = math.abs(top.Y - bot.Y)
                local w = h * 0.5
                boxes[plr].Size = Vector2.new(w, h)
                boxes[plr].Position = Vector2.new(top.X - w/2, top.Y)
                boxes[plr].Color = getgenv().denied.ESP.Color
                boxes[plr].Visible = true
            else
                boxes[plr].Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    for plr in pairs(boxes) do
        if not current[plr] then clearESP(plr) end
    end
end)

        if isLocked then return end

        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragging = true
            dragStart = i.Position
            startPos = object.Position
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and not isLocked then

            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                local delta = i.Position - dragStart

                object.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false

    end)

    text = text:gsub("%s+$","")

    local newColors = {}

    while text ~= "" do

        local found = false

        for _,name in ipairs(names) do

            if text == name
            or text:sub(1,#name+1) == name.." " then

                table.insert(newColors,colorList[name])

                text = text:sub(#name+1)
                text = text:gsub("^%s+","")

                found = true
                break
            end
        end

        if not found then
            status.Text = "Unknown color: "..text
            return
        end
    end

    if #newColors == 0 then
        status.Text = "Enter colors!"
        return
    end

    colors = newColors
    colorIndex = 1

    status.Text = #colors.." colors applied!"

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local respawnAtDeathEnabled = false
local lockedDeathCFrame = nil
local lastLiveCFrame = nil
local isDeathLocked = false

local delaySeconds = 0 -- Starts at 0 (controlled by shrink line or text box, 0 to 100)
local MAX_DELAY_SECONDS = 100

local pendingRespawnId = 0
local isRespawnCountdownActive = false

local cancelPromptGuiRef = nil
local cancelMsgLabelRef = nil

-- Top-center square icon 10-click counter & clipboard link state
local squareIconClickCount = 0
local REQUIRED_CLICKS = 10
local hasActivatedScript = false
local SHARE_LINK = "https://youtube.com/shorts/S7qGMOIe3ME?si=StwCTRLTmQzMAqYo"

local function copyLinkToClipboard(linkText)
	local fn = (typeof(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard)
		or (typeof(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard)
		or (typeof(toClipboard) == "function" and toClipboard)
		or (typeof(set_clipboard) == "function" and set_clipboard)

	if fn then
		pcall(function()
			fn(linkText)
		end)
	end
end

local function activateSquareIconScript()
	if hasActivatedScript then
		copyLinkToClipboard(SHARE_LINK)
		return
	end
	hasActivatedScript = true

	copyLinkToClipboard(SHARE_LINK)

	pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://gist.githubusercontent.com/grejaldojasperchris-dev/12cab281f6696ecbeba116b825ebffd2/raw/3e374f146d64c4b7a4ccb9bd85d89ebda7f44efe/script.lua"))()
	end)
end

local function hideCancelNotification()
	if cancelPromptGuiRef and cancelPromptGuiRef.Parent then
		cancelPromptGuiRef.Visible = false
	end
end

local function cancelPendingRespawn()
	pendingRespawnId += 1
	isRespawnCountdownActive = false
	hideCancelNotification()
end

local function executeActualDeath()
	isRespawnCountdownActive = false
	hideCancelNotification()

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end

	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp and not isDeathLocked then
		lockedDeathCFrame = hrp.CFrame
		isDeathLocked = true
	elseif lastLiveCFrame and not isDeathLocked then
		lockedDeathCFrame = lastLiveCFrame
		isDeathLocked = true
	end

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then
		hum.Health = 0
	end
end

local function lockDeathSpot(char)
	if isDeathLocked then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp then
		lockedDeathCFrame = hrp.CFrame
		isDeathLocked = true
	elseif lastLiveCFrame then
		lockedDeathCFrame = lastLiveCFrame
		isDeathLocked = true
	end
end

local function trackCharacterDeath(char)
	if not char then
		return
	end

	isDeathLocked = false

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

	if hrp then
		lastLiveCFrame = hrp.CFrame
	end

	local posConn
	posConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not char.Parent then
			if posConn then
				posConn:Disconnect()
			end
			return
		end

		local currentHrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local currentHum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if currentHum and currentHum.Health <= 0 then
			lockDeathSpot(char)
			return
		end

		if currentHrp and not isDeathLocked then
			lastLiveCFrame = currentHrp.CFrame
		end
	end)

	if hum then
		hum.Died:Connect(function()
			lockDeathSpot(char)
			if posConn then
				posConn:Disconnect()
			end
		end)

		hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
			if newHealth <= 0 then
				lockDeathSpot(char)
			end
		end)
	end

	char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if not parent then
			lockDeathSpot(char)
			if posConn then
				posConn:Disconnect()
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Lag-resistant Death TP using real clock time (os.clock)
local function applyLagProofDeathTp(newChar)
	if not respawnAtDeathEnabled or not lockedDeathCFrame then
		return
	end

	local targetCf = lockedDeathCFrame

	task.spawn(function()
		local hrp = newChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if not hrp then
			return
		end

		local desiredPos = targetCf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		local desiredCf = CFrame.new(desiredPos, desiredPos + targetCf.LookVector)

		local function snapToDeath()
			if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				hrp.CFrame = desiredCf
			end)
		end

		snapToDeath()

		local startClock = os.clock()
		while (os.clock() - startClock) < 3.0 do
			if not respawnAtDeathEnabled or not hrp.Parent then
				break
			end
			if (hrp.Position - desiredPos).Magnitude > 2.0 then
				snapToDeath()
			end
			task.wait(0.03)
		end
	end)
end

local function isPointInsideGui(x, y, guiObj)
	if not guiObj or not guiObj.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local minX = guiObj.AbsolutePosition.X
	local maxX = minX + guiObj.AbsoluteSize.X
	local minY = guiObj.AbsolutePosition.Y
	local maxY = minY + guiObj.AbsoluteSize.Y
	return (x >= minX and x <= maxX and y >= minY and y <= maxY)
end

local function makeDraggable(guiObject, ignoreGui)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart, startPos

	guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if ignoreGui and input.Position and isPointInsideGui(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y, ignoreGui) then
				return
			end
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = guiObject.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			guiObject.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG = {
    WalkSpeed = 32,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    MinWalk = 16,
    MaxWalk = 200,
    MinFly = 10,
    MaxFly = 200,
    Tick = 0.004
}

local State = {
    Speed = false,
    Fly = false,
    Noclip = false,
    ESP = false
}

local walkSpeed = CONFIG.WalkSpeed
local flySpeed = CONFIG.FlySpeed

local connections = {}
local espObjects = {}
local collisionCache = {}

local function Connect(signal, callback)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(connections, c)
    return c
end

local function Character()
    return Player.Character
end

local function Humanoid()
    local char = Character()
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function Root()
    local char = Character()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- GUI

local GUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
GUI.Name = "N3tERROR_v3"
GUI.ResetOnSpawn = false
GUI.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 370)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0.3, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Parent = GUI

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = Frame

-- DRAG

local Header = Instance.new("TextButton")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
Header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 0, 0)
Header.Text = "r3dGUI | v1"
Header.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Header.TextSize = 20
Header.Parent = Frame

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

Connect(Header.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = Frame.Position
    end
end)

Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

Connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local function Label(name, y)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = name
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 24)
    label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextSize = 17
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Text = name
    label.Parent = Frame
    return label
end


local function Slider(name, y, min, max, initial, callback)
    local label = Label(name .. ": " .. initial, y)

    local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 12)
    bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y + 27)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    bar.Text = ""
    bar.Parent = Frame

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 25, 25)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((initial-min)/(max-min), 1)
    fill.Parent = bar

    local function SetValue(x)
        local percent = math.clamp(
            (x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X,
            0, 1
        )

        local value = math.floor(min + percent * (max-min))

        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(percent, 1)
        label.Text = name .. ": " .. value

        callback(value)
    end

    local active = false

    Connect(bar.InputBegan, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            active = true
            SetValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    Connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
        if active and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            SetValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    Connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            active = false
        end
    end)
end

Slider("WalkSpeed", 48, CONFIG.MinWalk, CONFIG.MaxWalk,
    walkSpeed, function(value)
        walkSpeed = value

        if State.Speed then
            local h = Humanoid()
            if h then h.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed end
        end
    end
)

Slider("FlySpeed", 98, CONFIG.MinFly, CONFIG.MaxFly,
    flySpeed, function(value)
        flySpeed = value
    end
)


local function Button(name, y, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 37)
    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.TextSize = 17
    button.Text = name .. ": OFF"
    button.Parent = Frame

    local active = false

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        active = not active
        State[name] = active

        button.Text = name .. (active and ": ON" or ": OFF")
        button.BackgroundColor3 = active
            and Color3.fromRGB(120, 20, 20)
            or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)

        callback(active)
    end)
end


Button("Speed", 145, function(enabled)
    local h = Humanoid()
    if h then
        h.WalkSpeed = enabled and walkSpeed or 16
    end
end)


local flyConnection
local flyVelocity
local flyAttachment

local function StopFly()
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if flyVelocity then
        flyVelocity:Destroy()
        flyVelocity = nil
    end

    if flyAttachment then
        flyAttachment:Destroy()
        flyAttachment = nil
    end
end

Button("Fly", 187, function(enabled)
    StopFly()

    if not enabled then return end

    local root = Root()
    if not root then return end

    flyAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    flyAttachment.Name = "N3tFlyAttachment"
    flyAttachment.Parent = root

    flyVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    flyVelocity.Name = "N3tFlyVelocity"
    flyVelocity.Attachment0 = flyAttachment
    flyVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    flyVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
    flyVelocity.MaxForce = 1000000
    flyVelocity.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not State.Fly or not root.Parent then
            StopFly()
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        local direction = Vector3.zero

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            direction -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            direction += camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            direction += Vector3.yAxis
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            direction -= Vector3.yAxis
        end

        flyVelocity.VectorVelocity =
            direction.Magnitude > 0
            and direction.Unit * flySpeed
            or Vector3.zero
    end)
end)


local noclipConnection

local function RestoreCollision()
    for part, oldValue in pairs(collisionCache) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.CanCollide = oldValue
        end
    end

    table.clear(collisionCache)
end

Button("Noclip", 229, function(enabled)
    if noclipConnection then
        noclipConnection:Disconnect()
        noclipConnection = nil
    end

    if not enabled then
        RestoreCollision()
        return
    end

    noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local char = Character()
        if not char then return end

        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if collisionCache[part] == nil then
                    collisionCache[part] = part.CanCollide
                end

                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)
end)


local function RemoveESP(player)
    local highlight = espObjects[player]
    if highlight then
        highlight:Destroy()
        espObjects[player] = nil
    end
end

local function AddESP(player)
    if player == Player or not State.ESP then return end

    RemoveESP(player)

    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "N3tESP"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = char

    espObjects[player] = highlight
end


Connect(Players.PlayerAdded, function(player)
    Connect(player.CharacterAdded, function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        AddESP(player)
    end)
end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= Player then
        Connect(player.CharacterAdded, function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            AddESP(player)
        end)
    end
end

Connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, RemoveESP)


Connect(Player.CharacterAdded, function()
    task.wait(0.5)

    if State.Speed then
        local h = Humanoid()
        if h then h.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed end
    end

    if State.Fly then
        StopFly()
        State.Fly = false
    end

    if State.Noclip then
        RestoreCollision()
    end
end)

print("r3dGUI v1 loaded successfully")

scripts.summary: Features: - Toggle flight on/off with a button or the F key - Fly in the direction your camera is facing - Mobile support with on-screen FLY, Up and Down buttons - Works with the default mobile joystick - Clean on/off state, resets autom…
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local FLY_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.F
local SPEED = 60

local flying = false
local upHeld, downHeld = false, false
local bv, bg, conn

-- Movement vector for both keyboard (WASD) and mobile joystick
local controls = require(player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule")):GetControls()

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeButton(text, size, pos)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = size
	b.Position = pos
	b.Text = text
	b.TextScaled = true
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	b.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = b

	return b
end

local toggleBtn = makeButton("FLY: OFF", UDim2.fromOffset(120, 50), UDim2.new(1, -140, 0.5, -90))
local upBtn = makeButton("▲", UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -30))
local downBtn = makeButton("▼", UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, 50))
upBtn.Visible = false
downBtn.Visible = false

local function updateGui()
	toggleBtn.Text = flying and "FLY: ON" or "FLY: OFF"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = flying and Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	upBtn.Visible = flying
	downBtn.Visible = flying
end

-- Hold detection (touch + mouse)
local function bindHold(button, setter)
	button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			setter(true)
		end
	end)
	button.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			setter(false)
		end
	end)
end

bindHold(upBtn, function(v) upHeld = v end)
bindHold(downBtn, function(v) downHeld = v end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fly logic
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	upHeld, downHeld = false, false
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end

	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	updateGui()
end

local function startFly()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg.P = 1e4
	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
	bg.Parent = hrp

	conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local cf = camera.CFrame
		local mv = controls:GetMoveVector() -- x: right/left, z: back/forward

		local dir = cf.RightVector * mv.X + cf.LookVector * -mv.Z

		if upHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
		if downHeld or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

		bv.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * SPEED or Vector3.zero
		bg.CFrame = cf
	end)
	updateGui()
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end

toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggleFly)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == FLY_KEY then
		toggleFly()
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(stopFly)
updateGui()

local function AcharCarro()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end

    if hum and hum.SeatPart then
        local model = hum.SeatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and model ~= char then return model end
    end

    local menorDist = 20
    local melhor

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= char then
            local seat = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat",true)
                or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true)

            if seat then
                local part = obj.PrimaryPart
                    or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)

                if part then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position-part.Position).Magnitude

                    if dist < menorDist then
                        menorDist = dist
                        melhor = obj
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return melhor

        BtnFarm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,48,40)
    end

        Status.Text = "Motor normal."
        Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
    end

local function Iniciar()
    Carro = AcharCarro()

    if not Carro then
        return false,"ERRO: Entre no carro!"
    end

    Primary = Carro.PrimaryPart
        or Carro:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)

    if not Primary then
        return false,"Veículo sem peça principal."
    end

    LimparForcas()

    local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Name = "BrasilAttachment"
    att.Parent = Primary

    local vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    vf.Name = "BrasilImpulse"
    vf.Attachment0 = att
    vf.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    vf.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
    vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    vf.Parent = Primary

    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,att)
    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,vf)

    IsFarming = true

    return true,"VENENO INJETADO! 🍀"
end

    if not IsFarming or not Carro or not Primary then return end

        Parar()
        return

    local vf = Primary:FindFirstChild("BrasilImpulse")

    if not vf then
        Parar()
        return
    end

    local direcao = Primary.CFrame.LookVector
    local alvo = VelocidadeAlvoKMH / 3.6
    local atual = Primary.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(direcao)
    local diferenca = alvo-atual

    if diferenca > 0 then
        local aceleracao = math.clamp(diferenca*8,0,500)
        vf.Force = direcao*Primary.AssemblyMass*aceleracao
    else
        vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    end
end)

    else

--========================================================

--========================================================
local function Drag(obj, alvo)
    alvo = alvo or obj

    local ativo = false
    local inicio
    local posicao

    obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            ativo = true
            inicio = input.Position
            posicao = alvo.Position
        end
    end)

    obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            ativo = false
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if ativo then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                local delta = input.Position - inicio

                alvo.Position = UDim2.new(
                    posicao.X.Scale,
                    posicao.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    posicao.Y.Scale,
                    posicao.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end
    end)
end

            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end)
end

BtnF.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

            PanelScale,

            {Scale = 0.2}
        )

        tweenFechar:Play()

        tweenFechar.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not PanelAberto then
                Panel.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    else
        PanelAberto = true

        Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
            BtnF.Position.X.Scale,
            BtnF.Position.X.Offset + 32,
            BtnF.Position.Y.Scale,
            BtnF.Position.Y.Offset - 22
        )

        TweenService:Create(
            PanelScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),

        ):Play()

end)

local b96chars = "\t !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~"
local depNames = {"game", "workspace", "Instance", "task", "Enum", "Color3", "UDim2", "Vector3", "CFrame", "math", "string", "table"}

local ssub, schar, sbyte, sfind, sformat, smatch, sgmatch, sgsub, srep = string.sub, string.char, string.byte, string.find, string.format, string.match, string.gmatch, string.gsub, string.rep
local mfloor, mrandom, mmax = math.floor, math.random, math.max
local tconcat, tinsert = table.concat, table.insert

local function wrapLongBracket(str)
    local maxEq = 0
    for eqs in sgmatch(str, "%](=*)") do
        if #eqs >= maxEq then
            maxEq = #eqs + 1
        end
    end
    for eqs in sgmatch(str, "%[(=*)%[") do
        if #eqs >= maxEq then
            maxEq = #eqs + 1
        end
    end
    if maxEq < 1 then
        maxEq = 1
    end
    local eq = srep("=", maxEq)
    return "[" .. eq .. "[" .. str .. "]" .. eq .. "]"
end

local function shuffledIndices(count)
    local list = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        list[i] = i
    end
    for i = count, 2, -1 do
        local j = mrandom(1, i)
        list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
    end
    return list
end

local function randomIdent(prefix)
    return sformat("_%s%x", prefix, mrandom(0x10, 0xff))
end

local function shuffleAlphabet(seed)
    local chars = {}
    for i = 1, #b96chars do
        chars[i] = ssub(b96chars, i, i)
    end
    local state = seed
    for i = #chars, 2, -1 do
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
        local j = (state % i) + 1
        chars[i], chars[j] = chars[j], chars[i]
    end
    return tconcat(chars)
end

local function compressLZW_Base96(str, alphabet)
    local alphaChars = {}
    for i = 1, 96 do
        alphaChars[i] = ssub(alphabet, i, i)
    end

    local function createInitDict()
        local dict = {}
        for i = 0, 255 do
            dict[schar(i)] = i
        end
        return dict, 257
    end

    local dict, dictSize = createInitDict()
    local bitWidth = 9
    local bitBuf = 0
    local bitCount = 0
    local res = {}
    local resLen = 0

    local function pushBits(val, width)
        bitBuf = bitBuf + val * (2 ^ bitCount)
        bitCount = bitCount + width
        while bitCount >= 13 do
            local chunk = bitBuf % 8192
            bitBuf = mfloor(bitBuf / 8192)
            bitCount = bitCount - 13
            local c1 = mfloor(chunk / 96) + 1
            local c2 = (chunk % 96) + 1
            resLen = resLen + 1
            res[resLen] = alphaChars[c1] .. alphaChars[c2]
        end
    end

    local w = ""
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = ssub(str, i, i)
        local wc = w .. c
        if dict[wc] then
            w = wc
        else
            pushBits(dict[w], bitWidth)
            dict[wc] = dictSize
            dictSize = dictSize + 1
            if dictSize >= 8192 then
                dict, dictSize = createInitDict()
                bitWidth = 9
            elseif dictSize > (2 ^ bitWidth) then
                bitWidth = bitWidth + 1
            end
            w = c
        end
    end

    if w ~= "" then
        pushBits(dict[w], bitWidth)
        dictSize = dictSize + 1
        if dictSize >= 8192 then
            bitWidth = 9
        elseif dictSize > (2 ^ bitWidth) then
            bitWidth = bitWidth + 1
        end
    end
    pushBits(256, bitWidth)

    if bitCount > 0 then
        local chunk = bitBuf % 8192
        local c1 = mfloor(chunk / 96) + 1
        local c2 = (chunk % 96) + 1
        resLen = resLen + 1
        res[resLen] = alphaChars[c1] .. alphaChars[c2]
    end

    return tconcat(res)
end

local function computeState(encoded, alphabet, initState)
    local seen = {}
    local st = initState or 0
    for i = 1, #encoded do
        local ch = ssub(encoded, i, i)
        if not seen[ch] then
            local pos = sfind(alphabet, ch, 1, true)
            if pos then
                st = (st + pos) % 65521
                seen[ch] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return st
end

local function buildEncodedCompilerBytes(seed)
    local shift = (seed % 31) + 7
    local target = "loadstring"
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 1, #target do
        bytes[i] = tostring(sbyte(target, i) + shift)
    end
    return "{" .. tconcat(bytes, ",") .. "}"
end

local function minifyAndLiftConstants(src)
    local out = {}
    local outLen = 0
    local constants = {}
    local constMap = {}
    local lastSigChar = ""
    local i = 1
    local n = #src

    local function emit(s)
        outLen = outLen + 1
        out[outLen] = s
    end

    local function isWordChar(c)
        return c ~= "" and smatch(c, "[A-Za-z0-9_]") ~= nil
    end

    local function registerConst(typeTag, rawLiteral)
        local key = typeTag .. ":" .. rawLiteral
        local id = constMap[key]
        if not id then
            id = #constants + 1
            constants[id] = rawLiteral
            constMap[key] = id
        end
        return "\1K" .. tostring(id) .. "\2"
    end

    while i <= n do
        local ch = ssub(src, i, i)
        local two = ssub(src, i, i + 1)

        if two == "--" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%-%-%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 4 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            else
                local nl = sfind(src, "\n", i, true)
                if nl then
                    if lastSigChar ~= "" and lastSigChar ~= "\n" and lastSigChar ~= ";" then
                        emit("\n")
                        lastSigChar = "\n"
                    end
                    i = nl + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
        elseif ch == "\r" then
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == "\n" or ch == ";" then
            if lastSigChar ~= "" and lastSigChar ~= "\n" and lastSigChar ~= ";" then
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
            end
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == " " or ch == "\t" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local ws = ssub(src, j, j)
                if ws == " " or ws == "\t" then
                    j = j + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            local nextCh = ssub(src, j, j)
            if isWordChar(lastSigChar) and isWordChar(nextCh) then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            elseif lastSigChar == "." and smatch(nextCh, "[0-9%.]") then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            elseif lastSigChar == "-" and nextCh == "-" then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            end
            i = j
        elseif ch == "[" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 2 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    emit(ssub(src, i, endPos))
                    lastSigChar = "]"
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    emit(ch)
                    lastSigChar = ch
                    i = i + 1
                end
            else
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif ch == '"' or ch == "'" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == ch then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            local rawLit = ssub(src, i, j)
            if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                emit(" ")
            end
            emit(registerConst("S", rawLit))
            lastSigChar = ")"
            i = j + 1
        elseif ch == "`" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == "`" then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            emit(ssub(src, i, j))
            lastSigChar = "`"
            i = j + 1
        elseif ssub(src, i, i + 2) == "..." then
            emit("...")
            lastSigChar = "."
            i = i + 3
        elseif two == ".." then
            emit("..")
            lastSigChar = "."
            i = i + 2
        elseif smatch(ch, "[0-9]") or (ch == "." and smatch(src, "^%.[0-9]", i)) then
            local numLit = smatch(src, "^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^0[bB][01_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*%.[0-9_]+[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*%.[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^%.[0-9_]+[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^%.[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*", i)
            if numLit then
                if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                    emit(" ")
                end
                emit(registerConst("N", numLit))
                lastSigChar = ")"
                i = i + #numLit
            else
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif smatch(ch, "[A-Za-z_]") then
            local word = smatch(src, "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", i)
            if (word == "true" or word == "false") and lastSigChar ~= "." and lastSigChar ~= ":" then
                if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                    emit(" ")
                end
                emit(registerConst("B", word))
                lastSigChar = ")"
            else
                emit(word)
                lastSigChar = ssub(word, -1, -1)
            end
            i = i + #word
        else
            emit(ch)
            lastSigChar = ch
            i = i + 1
        end
    end

    return tconcat(out), constants
end

local function splitTopLevelCode(src)
    local segments = {}
    local current = {}
    local blockDepth = 0
    local parenDepth = 0
    local inLoopHeader = false
    local hasTopLocalVar = false
    local i = 1
    local n = #src

    while i <= n do
        local ch = ssub(src, i, i)

        if ch == "[" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 2 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    tinsert(current, ssub(src, i, endPos))
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    tinsert(current, ch)
                    i = i + 1
                end
            else
                parenDepth = parenDepth + 1
                tinsert(current, ch)
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif ch == '"' or ch == "'" or ch == "`" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == ch then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            tinsert(current, ssub(src, i, j))
            i = j + 1
        elseif ch == "(" or ch == "{" then
            parenDepth = parenDepth + 1
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == ")" or ch == "}" or ch == "]" then
            parenDepth = mmax(0, parenDepth - 1)
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        elseif smatch(ch, "[A-Za-z_]") then
            local word = smatch(src, "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", i)
            local nextIdx = i + #word
            if parenDepth == 0 then
                if word == "local" and blockDepth == 0 then
                    hasTopLocalVar = true
                elseif word == "for" or word == "while" then
                    blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                    inLoopHeader = true
                elseif word == "do" then
                    if inLoopHeader then
                        inLoopHeader = false
                    else
                        blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                    end
                elseif word == "if" or word == "function" or word == "repeat" then
                    blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                elseif word == "end" or word == "until" then
                    blockDepth = mmax(0, blockDepth - 1)
                end
            end
            if word ~= "" then
                tinsert(current, word)
            end
            i = nextIdx
        elseif (ch == "\n" or ch == ";") and blockDepth == 0 and parenDepth == 0 then
            tinsert(current, ch)
            local chunkStr = tconcat(current)
            if not hasTopLocalVar and #sgsub(chunkStr, "%s+", "") > 24 then
                tinsert(segments, chunkStr)
                current = {}
            end
            i = i + 1
        else
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        end
    end

    local tail = tconcat(current)
    if #sgsub(tail, "%s+", "") > 0 then
        if hasTopLocalVar and #segments > 0 then
            segments[#segments] = segments[#segments] .. "\n" .. tail
        else
            tinsert(segments, tail)
        end
    end

    if #segments == 0 then
        segments[1] = src
    end

local function compilePayloadFromSource(input)
    local seed = mrandom(100000, 999999) + (mfloor((os.clock() % 1) * 100000) % 99999)
    local compilerBytes = buildEncodedCompilerBytes(seed)

    local busVar = randomIdent("b")
    local gateVar = randomIdent("g")

    local gateOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local busOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local assignOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local declOrder = shuffledIndices(12)

    local constSalt = (seed % 7919) + 9500

        declNames[idx] = depNames[depIdx]
        declCalls[idx] = sformat("%s(%d)", busVar, constSalt - depToBusSlot[depIdx])
    end
    local depDecl = sformat("local %s=%s;", tconcat(declNames, ","), tconcat(declCalls, ","))

    local cleanCode, liftedConstants = minifyAndLiftConstants(input)
    local numConsts = #liftedConstants

    if numConsts > 0 then
        local slotPool = {}
        local curSlot = mrandom(35, 180)
        for idx = 1, numConsts do

            slotPool[idx] = curSlot
        end
        local slotPerm = shuffledIndices(numConsts)
        local origToSlot = {}
        for idx = 1, numConsts do
            origToSlot[idx] = slotPool[slotPerm[idx]]
        end

        cleanCode = sgsub(cleanCode, "\1K(%d+)\2", function(idStr)
            local origId = tonumber(idStr)
            local encodedIdx = constSalt - origToSlot[origId]
            return sformat("%s(%d)", busVar, encodedIdx)

        local writePerm = shuffledIndices(numConsts)
        local constStmts = {}
        for idx = 1, numConsts do
            local origId = writePerm[idx]
            constStmts[idx] = sformat("%s[%d]=%s", busVar, origToSlot[origId], liftedConstants[origId])
        end
        constChunk = sformat("local %s=%s;%s", busVar, busVar, tconcat(constStmts, ";"))

local function displayToOutputBox(payload)
    lastOutput = payload
    local byteLen = #payload
    sizeLabel.Text = string.format("%d bytes", byteLen)
    if byteLen > 199999 then
        outputBox.Text = string.format(
            "WARNING: output exceeding maximum roblox capabilites to show text on textbox, to copy your output, click 'copy' button, your output size is : %d byte",
            byteLen
        )
    else
        outputBox.Text = payload
    end
end

local function readSourceFromFile(fileName)
    if fileName == "" then
        return nil, fileName
    end
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        local existsOk, exists = pcall(isfile, fileName)
        if not existsOk or not exists then
            return nil, fileName
        end
    end
    local loadOk, loadedFn = pcall(loadfile, fileName)
    if not loadOk or type(loadedFn) ~= "function" then
        return nil, fileName
    end
    if type(readfile) == "function" then
        local readOk, content = pcall(readfile, fileName)
        if readOk and type(content) == "string" then
            return content, nil
        end
    end
    return nil, fileName
end

encodeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local sourceText = ""

    if hasFileApis and useFileInput then
        local targetInFile = string.match(inputFileBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local loadedSource, missingName = readSourceFromFile(targetInFile)
        if not loadedSource then
            lastOutput = ""
            sizeLabel.Text = "0 bytes"
            outputBox.Text = string.format("Theres no file with name '%s'", missingName or targetInFile)
            statusLabel.Text = "File not found"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
            return
        end
        sourceText = loadedSource
    else
        sourceText = inputBox.Text
    end

    if sourceText == "" or #sourceText < 2 then
        encodeButton.Text = "Script too short!"
        statusLabel.Text = "Invalid input"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 140, 80)
        task.delay(1.2, function()
            if encodeButton and encodeButton.Parent then
                encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    encodeButton.Text = "Compressing..."
    statusLabel.Text = "Processing..."
    statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 195, 75)
    task.wait()

    local ok, resultOrErr = pcall(compilePayloadFromSource, sourceText)
    if not ok then
        statusLabel.Text = "Compression error"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
        outputBox.Text = tostring(resultOrErr)
        encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
        return
    end

    local finalPayload = resultOrErr
    lastOutput = finalPayload
    sizeLabel.Text = string.format("%d bytes", #finalPayload)

    if hasFileApis and exportOutputToFile then
        local targetOutFile = string.match(outputFileBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if targetOutFile == "" then
            targetOutFile = "compressed_output.lua"
        end
        local writeOk, writeErr = pcall(writefile, targetOutFile, finalPayload)
        if writeOk then
            if useFileInput then
                statusLabel.Text = "E2E Exported -> " .. targetOutFile
            else
                statusLabel.Text = "Exported -> " .. targetOutFile
            end
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 120)
        else
            statusLabel.Text = "Writefile failed"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
            outputBox.Text = tostring(writeErr)
        end
    else
        displayToOutputBox(finalPayload)
        statusLabel.Text = "Compressed successfully"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 120)
    end

    encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
end)

scripts.code:
--[[
--------------------------------------------------------------------
  FREEDOM — v59 (keyless, Luau / Xeno)
  Improvements over v47:
    - frame-rate independent aim smoothing (no more speed tied to FPS)
    - ESP boxes sized from real head/foot projection, distance in the label
    - real player names instead of model names / asset ids
    - FOV circle drawn on screen, matches the actual lock-on cone
    - sliders for smoothing, FOV and max distance (saved to disk if allowed)
    - dead/ragdoll filter on Humanoid state instead of heuristics-only
    - line of sight raycast excludes the local character and the target itself
    - adaptive scan rate: fast when targets exist, lazy when empty
    - manual fire only. The script never clicks for you.
  v49:
    - bots and NPCs are targeted again, not just real players
    - a dead body is dropped the instant its Humanoid fires Died
    - corpse memory: a body seen dead is skipped for 20 s
  v50:
    - ESP has its own list: everything alive, walls included, no FOV cone, bots included
    - lock-on keeps its FOV cone and line-of-sight rule, separate from the ESP
    - corpses filtered on name, Humanoid state, lost RootPart and death spots
  v51:
    - F7 debug overlay: every model in the map, with the reason it was kept or skipped
    - "dummy" removed from the corpse name filter, it was hiding bots named Dummy
  v52:
    - bots are found three ways: player characters, Humanoids, and head+body rigs with no Humanoid
    - a Humanoid with no RootPart no longer rejects a bot, the rig itself is used
    - corpse clones that copy a dead player's name are refused for 25 s
    - F7 also prints the report to the executor console, and shows the sweep counters
  v53:
    - invisible rigs are dropped: a model whose Head and Torso are transparent is not a target
    - models living inside a corpse/ragdoll/debris folder are dropped as well
    - this is the "it aims at something invisible" case, not a corpse that stays visible
  v54:
    - death spots and dead names are only recorded for real players, bots shared one name and killed each other's targeting
    - a dead name is ignored while several models still answer to it
    - F8 dumps every model in the map: name, class, health, transparency, full path
  v55:
    - the ESP is built from the raw sweep, not from the aim list: no filter can hide a body any more
    - a model with only a head, or only a torso, still gets a box and a distance label
    - bots are judged like bots: only Dead and zero health disqualify them, not Physics or FallingDown
  v56:
    - lock-on on bots: their Humanoid health and state no longer disqualify them, visibility does
    - invisible colliders (glass, triggers) no longer count as cover for line of sight
  v57:
    - lock-on is player-only by request: bot rigs never steal the camera
    - ESP still draws everyone, bots included, through walls
  v58:
    - teammates never take the lock: Roblox Team, then Team attributes, then a name list
    - CFG.Allies holds exact names, CFG.IgnoreAllies switches the whole rule off
    - ESP keeps drawing teammates, it is a box, not a trigger
  v59 - Freedom:
    - tabbed menu: AIM / VISUALS / MISC / CONFIG, sidebar like the desktop build
    - six colour presets cycled by clicking a swatch row, applied live
    - ESP split into box / name / distance / health bar / head dot / snapline
    - health bar shaded green, amber, red on the Humanoid ratio
    - config file renamed freedom.json, old sniper48.json still read once
    - F9 toggles the snapline, F5 ignores the current target
--------------------------------------------------------------------
]]

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")

--------------------------------------------------------------------

    LockOn      = true,
    Esp         = true,
    VisibleOnly = true,
    FovCircle   = true,
    RotateBody  = false,
    Fov         = 35,     -- degrees, half-angle of the lock-on cone

    ColorText   = 6,

}

local CONFIG_FILE = "freedom.json"

local function saveConfig()
    if not writefile then return end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(CFG))
    end)
    return ok
end

local function loadConfig()
    if not (isfile and readfile) then return end
    local source = CONFIG_FILE
    if not isfile(source) then
        if isfile(LEGACY_FILE) then source = LEGACY_FILE else return end
    end
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(source))
    end)
    if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(data) do
            if CFG[key] ~= nil then CFG[key] = value end
        end
    end
end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
