--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GAME HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local DEAD_STATES = {
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding] = true,
}

-- games keep corpses around: as a ragdoll, as a renamed clone, or as a dummy
-- that still reports full health. Those words are the ones they never use for a living body.
-- only names a living body never carries. "dummy" is deliberately absent:
-- plenty of games call their bots Dummy or BotDummy, and that filter was hiding them.
local CORPSE_WORDS = { "ragdoll", "corpse", "deadbody", "dead_body" }

local function looksLikeCorpse(character)
    local lower = string.lower(character.Name or "")
    for _, word in ipairs(CORPSE_WORDS) do
        if string.find(lower, word, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- a corpse clone keeps the name of the player it came from. Remember it and
-- refuse any model carrying that name, since no living body answers to it.
local deadNames = {}

local function markDeadName(name)
    if name and #name > 0 then deadNames[name] = os.clock() + 25 end
end

local function isDeadName(character)
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then return false end
    local name = character.Name
    if not name then return false end
    local expiry = deadNames[name]
    if not expiry then return false end
    if os.clock() > expiry then
        deadNames[name] = nil
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local HIDDEN_PARTS = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }
local CORPSE_CONTAINERS = { "corpse", "ragdoll", "deadbody", "bodies", "debris" }

local function inCorpseContainer(character)
    local node = character.Parent
    local depth = 0
    while node and node ~= Workspace and depth < 6 do
        local name = string.lower(tostring(node.Name))
        for _, word in ipairs(CORPSE_CONTAINERS) do
            if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then return true end
        end
        node = node.Parent
        depth = depth + 1
    end
    return false
end

-- a body the game hides is still a body. Aiming a box at a transparent rig
-- looks exactly like locking onto thin air, which is what players report.
local function isHidden(character)
    local found = false
    for _, partName in ipairs(HIDDEN_PARTS) do
        local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            found = true
            if part.Transparency < 0.85 then return false end
        end
    end
    return found
end

local function hasBodyPart(character)
    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or character.PrimaryPart
end

local function isAlive(character)
    if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
    if looksLikeCorpse(character) then return false end
    if isHidden(character) then return false end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= nil
    if humanoid then
        if isPlayer then
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            if DEAD_STATES[humanoid:GetState()] then return false end
            return hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
        end
        -- bots: a visible rig with a body part is a target. Their Humanoid is
        -- decoration — plenty sit at zero health or in Physics for their whole life.
        return hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
    end
    -- no Humanoid at all: some games ship bots as plain rigs, head + body only
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil and hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
end

local function partsOf(character)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not rootPart then
        local primary = character.PrimaryPart
        if primary then rootPart = primary end
    end
    return head, rootPart
end

local function nameOf(character)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if player then return player.DisplayName ~= "" and player.DisplayName or player.Name end
    local name = character.Name or "bot"
    if #name >= 32 and name:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x-") then return "bot" end
    if #name > 20 then return string.sub(name, 1, 18) .. ".." end
    return name
end

-- A teammate must never eat the lock. Roblox teams first, then any Team
-- attribute the game sets, then a hand-written name list in the config.
local function isAlly(character)
    if not CFG.IgnoreAllies then return false end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if not player then return false end

    if lp.Team ~= nil and player.Team == lp.Team then return true end

    for _, key in ipairs({ "Team", "team", "TeamName", "teamName", "TeamId", "teamId" }) do
        local mine, theirs = lp:GetAttribute(key), player:GetAttribute(key)
        if mine ~= nil and theirs ~= nil and mine == theirs then return true end
        local myBody, theirBody = lp.Character, player.Character
        if myBody and theirBody then
            local mineC, theirsC = myBody:GetAttribute(key), theirBody:GetAttribute(key)
            if mineC ~= nil and theirsC ~= nil and mineC == theirsC then return true end
        end
    end

    for _, name in ipairs(CFG.Allies or {}) do
        local lowered = string.lower(tostring(name))
        if lowered == string.lower(player.Name) then return true end
        if player.DisplayName and lowered == string.lower(player.DisplayName) then return true end
    end

    return false
end

local corpses = {}

local function markCorpse(character, seconds)
    if character then corpses[character] = os.clock() + (seconds or CFG.CorpseHold) end
end

local function isCorpse(character)
    local expiry = corpses[character]
    if not expiry then return false end
    if not character.Parent or os.clock() > expiry then
        corpses[character] = nil
        return false
    end
    return true
end

-- games often spawn a fresh ragdoll model where the body fell. Remember the
-- spot of every death for a few seconds and refuse anything standing there.
local deathSpots = {}

local function markDeathSpot(position)
    if not position then return end
    deathSpots[#deathSpots + 1] = { pos = position, at = os.clock() }
    while #deathSpots > 30 do table.remove(deathSpots, 1) end
end

local function nearDeathSpot(character, rootPart)
    if not rootPart then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    local where = rootPart.Position
    for index = #deathSpots, 1, -1 do
        local spot = deathSpots[index]
        if now - spot.at > 8 then
            table.remove(deathSpots, index)
        elseif (spot.pos - where).Magnitude <= 6 then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function canSee(character, targetPart)
    if not targetPart then return false end
    local ignored = { character }
    if lp.Character then ignored[#ignored + 1] = lp.Character end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, rayParams)
    if not result then return true end
    if result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then return true end
    -- invisible colliders are not cover: glass walls and trigger boxes must not
    -- block a line of sight that the eye clearly has
    if result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and result.Instance.Transparency >= 0.85 then return true end
    return false
end

-- CHARACTER SWEEP (players + bots)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function sweepCharacters()
    local found, seen = {}, {}
    local humanoids, rigs = 0, 0

    for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if other ~= lp then
            local character = other.Character
            if character and character.Parent then
                found[#found + 1] = character
                seen[character] = true
            end
        end
    end

    if CFG.IncludeBots then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    humanoids = humanoids + 1
                    local model = descendant.Parent
                    if model and not seen[model] and model ~= lp.Character then
                        seen[model] = true
                        found[#found + 1] = model
                    end
                elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name == "Head" then
                    local model = descendant.Parent
                    if model and not seen[model] and model ~= lp.Character
                        and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                             or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) then
                        seen[model] = true
                        rigs = rigs + 1
                        found[#found + 1] = model
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            State.errors = State.errors + 1
        end
    end

    local nameCount = {}
    for _, model in ipairs(found) do
        local name = model.Name
        nameCount[name] = (nameCount[name] or 0) + 1
    end
    State.nameCount = nameCount
    State.sweepInfo = string.format("sweep %d models (%d humanoid, %d rigs)", #found, humanoids, rigs)
    State.characters = found
    State.lastSweep = os.clock()
    return found
end

-- F8: the whole map, unfiltered. Every model holding a Humanoid or a body part
-- gets one line: name, class, health, transparency, full path. Nothing is judged.
function dumpWorld()
    local seen, rows = {}, {}
    local ok = pcall(function()
        for _, item in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            local candidate = item:IsA("Humanoid")
                or (item:IsA("BasePart") and (item.Name == "Head"
                    or item.Name == "Torso" or item.Name == "UpperTorso"))
            if candidate then
                local model = item.Parent
                if model and not seen[model] then
                    seen[model] = true
                    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    rows[#rows + 1] = string.format("%s [%s] hp=%s transp=%s/%s path=%s",
                        model.Name,
                        model.ClassName,
                        humanoid and tostring(math.floor(humanoid.Health)) or "-",
                        head and string.format("%.2f", head.Transparency) or "-",
                        torso and string.format("%.2f", torso.Transparency) or "-",
                        model:GetFullName())
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    print(string.format("[freedom] dump %d model(s)%s", #rows, ok and "" or " — scan error"))
    for index = 1, math.min(#rows, 40) do
        print("[freedom] " .. rows[index])
    end
end

local function watchDeath(character)
    if State.deathHooks[character] then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    local ok, connection = pcall(function()
        return humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            State.deathHooks[character] = nil
            markCorpse(character)
            -- only a real player leaves a corpse worth remembering: bots die by the
            -- dozen in the same spot, and their shared names poison every filter
            if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
                markDeadName(character.Name)
                local dyingRoot = humanoid.RootPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                markDeathSpot(dyingRoot and dyingRoot.Position)
            end
            if State.target and State.target.character == character then
                State.target = nil
                State.lastScan = 0
            end
        end)
    end)
    if ok then State.deathHooks[character] = connection end
end

local function scanTargets()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - State.lastSweep >= CFG.BotScan then
        sweepCharacters()
    end

    local list = {}
    local espList = {}
    local report = {}
    local visibleCount = 0
    local totalCount = 0
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize

    for _, character in ipairs(State.characters) do
        local reason = nil
        local isPlayerModel = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= nil
        local ally = isAlly(character)
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not character.Parent then
            reason = "gone"
        elseif character == lp.Character then
            reason = "self"
        elseif isCorpse(character) then
            reason = "corpse-memory"
        elseif looksLikeCorpse(character) then
            reason = "corpse-name"
        elseif isDeadName(character) and (State.nameCount[character.Name] or 0) <= 1 then
            reason = "corpse-name-match"
        elseif inCorpseContainer(character) then
            reason = "corpse-folder"
        elseif isHidden(character) then
            reason = "invisible"
        elseif not humanoid then
            reason = "no-humanoid"
        elseif humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            reason = "hp0"
        elseif DEAD_STATES[humanoid:GetState()] then
            reason = "state"
        elseif not humanoid.RootPart or not humanoid.RootPart.Parent then
            reason = "no-root"
        end

        if reason then
            report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  %s", nameOf(character), reason)
        else
            local head, rootPart = partsOf(character)
            if nearDeathSpot(character, rootPart) then
                markCorpse(character, 8)
                report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  death-spot", nameOf(character))
            else
            totalCount = totalCount + 1
            local aimPart = head or rootPart
            -- lock-on is for real players only, and never for a teammate
            if isPlayerModel and not ally and aimPart and aimPart.Parent then
                local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
                local delta = aimPart.Position - origin
                local distance = delta.Magnitude
                if distance <= CFG.MaxDist then
                    watchDeath(character)
                    -- ESP: everything alive around us, bots included, walls included.
                    -- Only things actually in front of the camera get drawn, nothing behind the head.
                    -- ESP is built separately, from the raw sweep: see below

                    -- Lock-on stays inside the FOV cone and respects line of sight
                    local dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                    local unit = delta.Unit
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(clamp(dir:Dot(unit), -1, 1)))
                    if angle <= CFG.Fov then
                        local visible = (not CFG.VisibleOnly) or canSee(character, aimPart)
                        if visible then
                            visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
                            list[#list + 1] = {
                                character = character,
                                head = head,
                                root = rootPart,
                                aim = aimPart,
                                name = nameOf(character),
                                distance = distance,
                                angle = angle,
                                score = angle * 0.7 + (distance / math.max(CFG.MaxDist, 1)) * 30,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            end -- nearDeathSpot guard
        end
    end

    -- ESP: built from the raw sweep, never from the aim list. A body the aim
    -- filters reject still gets a box, which is the whole point of an overlay.
    for _, character in ipairs(State.characters) do
        if character.Parent and character ~= lp.Character and not isCorpse(character) then
            local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local body = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                or character.PrimaryPart
            local anchor = head or body
            if anchor and anchor.Parent then
                local headHidden = (not head) or head.Transparency >= 0.85
                local bodyHidden = (not body) or body.Transparency >= 0.85
                if not (headHidden and bodyHidden) then
                    local distance = (anchor.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance <= CFG.MaxDist then
                        local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(anchor.Position)
                        if onScreen and screen.Z > 0
                            and screen.X > -200 and screen.X < viewport.X + 200
                            and screen.Y > -200 and screen.Y < viewport.Y + 200 then
                            espList[#espList + 1] = {
                                character = character,
                                head = head or body,
                                root = body or head,
                                aim = anchor,
                                name = nameOf(character),
                                distance = distance,
                                score = distance,
                            }
                            report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  esp %.0fm", nameOf(character), distance / 3.571)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.score < b.score end)
    table.sort(espList, function(a, b) return a.score < b.score end)
    State.candidates = list
    State.espList = espList
    State.report = report
    State.aliveCount = #State.characters
    State.visible = visibleCount
    State.total = totalCount
    State.target = list[1]
    return list[1]
end

-- AIM
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function aimAt(target, dt)
    if not target or not cam then return end
    local desired = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, target.aim.Position)
    -- exponential smoothing: same feel at 30 fps and at 240 fps
    local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-CFG.Smooth * dt)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(desired, clamp(alpha, 0, 1))

    if CFG.RotateBody and lp.Character then
        local myRoot = lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
            local bodyWant = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, target.aim.Position)
            local bodyAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-10 * dt)
            myRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame:Lerp(bodyWant, clamp(bodyAlpha, 0, 1))
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESP RENDER
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function renderEsp()
    if not drawingOk then return end
    local used = 0
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local boxColor = palColor(CFG.ColorBox)
    local textColor = palColor(CFG.ColorText)
    local lineColor = palColor(CFG.ColorSnapline)

    for _, entry in ipairs(State.espList) do
        local head = entry.head or entry.aim
        local bodyPart = entry.root or entry.aim or entry.head
        if head and bodyPart then
            local headScreen, headOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
            local footScreen, footOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bodyPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
            if headOn and footOn and headScreen.Z > 0 and footScreen.Z > 0 then
                used = used + 1
                if used <= CFG.MaxTargets then
                    local box = boxAt(used)
                    if box then
                        local height = math.abs(footScreen.Y - headScreen.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.5
                        local top = math.min(headScreen.Y, footScreen.Y)
                        local left = headScreen.X - width * 0.5

                        box.square.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                        box.square.Position = Vector2.new(left, top)
                        box.square.Color = boxColor
                        box.square.Filled = CFG.BoxFill
                        box.square.Transparency = CFG.BoxFill and 0.7 or 1
                        box.square.Visible = CFG.Esp

                        -- barre de vie, proportion Humanoid
                        local humanoid = entry.character and entry.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or 100
                        local maxHealth = math.max(humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth or 100, 1)
                        local ratio = clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
                        local barX = left - 5
                        box.barBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                        box.barBg.Position = Vector2.new(barX, top)
                        box.barBg.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHealth
                        box.barFill.Size = Vector2.new(3, height * ratio)
                        box.barFill.Position = Vector2.new(barX, top + height * (1 - ratio))
                        if ratio > 0.6 then
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(96, 220, 128)
                        elseif ratio > 0.3 then
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 205, 96)
                        else
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90)
                        end
                        box.barFill.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHealth

                        -- point de tete
                        box.headDot.Position = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, headScreen.Y)
                        box.headDot.Color = boxColor
                        box.headDot.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHeadDot

                        -- ligne depuis le bas de l'ecran
                        box.line.From = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y)
                        box.line.To = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, top)
                        box.line.Color = lineColor
                        box.line.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspSnapline

                        -- etiquette : nom et/ou distance, chacun son interrupteur
                        local parts = {}
                        if CFG.EspName then parts[#parts + 1] = entry.name end
                        if CFG.EspDist then
                            parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%dm", math.floor(entry.distance / 3.571))
                        end
                        box.text.Text = table.concat(parts, "  ")
                        box.text.Position = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, top - 15)
                        box.text.Color = textColor
                        box.text.Visible = CFG.Esp and #parts > 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for index = math.min(used, CFG.MaxTargets) + 1, #boxCache do
        hideBox(index)
    end
end

local function renderFov()
    if not fovCircle then return end
    if not CFG.FovCircle or not CFG.LockOn then
        fovCircle.Visible = false
        return
    end
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local halfFov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView * 0.5)
    local radius = (math.tan(math.rad(CFG.Fov)) / math.tan(halfFov)) * (viewport.Y * 0.5)
    fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    fovCircle.Radius = math.max(radius, 1)
    fovCircle.Visible = true
end

-- IGNORE LIST (F5)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local ignored = {}
local IGNORE_SECONDS = 30

local function isIgnored(character)
    local expiry = ignored[character]
    if not expiry then return false end
    if os.clock() > expiry then
        ignored[character] = nil
        return false
    end
    return true
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- IGNORE TOGGLE (F5 and the menu button)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function toggleIgnore()
    local target = State.target
    if not (target and target.character) then return end
    if isIgnored(target.character) then
        ignored[target.character] = nil
    else
        ignored[target.character] = os.clock() + IGNORE_SECONDS
    end
end

ignoreRef = toggleIgnore
dumpWorldRef = dumpWorld

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RENDER LOOP
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function onRender(dt)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        dt = clamp(dt or 0, 0, 0.1)
        if not cam or not cam.Parent then
            cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
        end

        local now = os.clock()
        local interval = (#State.candidates > 0) and CFG.ScanFast or CFG.ScanSlow
        if now - State.lastScan >= interval then
            State.lastScan = now
            scanTargets()
        end

        -- a target that died or lost its hitbox is dropped on the spot
        if State.target then
            local t = State.target
            local stillThere = t.character and t.character.Parent
                and t.aim and t.aim.Parent
                and not isCorpse(t.character)
                and isAlive(t.character)
            if not stillThere then
                markCorpse(t.character)
                State.target = nil
                State.lastScan = 0
                scanTargets()
            end
        end

        -- filter ignored targets without rescanning
        if State.target and isIgnored(State.target.character) then
            for _, entry in ipairs(State.candidates) do
                if not isIgnored(entry.character) then
                    State.target = entry
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if CFG.LockOn and State.target then
            aimAt(State.target, dt)
        end

        if CFG.Esp then
            local espOk = pcall(renderEsp)
            if not espOk then
                State.errors = State.errors + 1
                drawingOk = false
            end
        else
            for index = 1, #boxCache do hideBox(index) end
        end

        renderFov()
        refreshUi()
    end)

    if not ok then
        State.errors = State.errors + 1
    end
end

pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("Freedom59") end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("Freedom59", 201, onRender)

local keyConnection = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    local key = input.KeyCode

    if key == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        CFG.UiVisible = not CFG.UiVisible
        root.Visible = CFG.UiVisible
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
        CFG.LockOn = not CFG.LockOn
        for _, paint in ipairs(painters) do paint() end
        saveConfig()
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F3 then
        CFG.Esp = not CFG.Esp
        for _, paint in ipairs(painters) do paint() end
        saveConfig()
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F4 then
        copyInvite()
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F5 then
        local target = State.target
        if target and target.character then
            if isIgnored(target.character) then
                ignored[target.character] = nil
            else
                ignored[target.character] = os.clock() + IGNORE_SECONDS
            end
        end
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then
        CFG.FovCircle = not CFG.FovCircle
        for _, paint in ipairs(painters) do paint() end
        saveConfig()
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F7 then
        CFG.Debug = not CFG.Debug
        debugBox.Visible = CFG.Debug
        print("[freedom] debug " .. (CFG.Debug and "on" or "off"))
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F8 then
        dumpWorld()
    elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.F9 then
        CFG.EspSnapline = not CFG.EspSnapline
        for _, paint in ipairs(painters) do paint() end
        saveConfig()
    end
end)

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = root.Position
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        root.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local function shutdown()
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("Freedom59") end)
    pcall(function() keyConnection:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    for _, entry in pairs(boxCache) do
        for _, item in pairs(entry) do
            if type(item) == "table" or type(item) == "userdata" then
                pcall(function() item:Remove() end)
            end
        end
    end
    if fovCircle then pcall(function() fovCircle:Remove() end) end
    boxCache = {}
    _G.SNIPER48 = nil
end

_G.SNIPER48 = { shutdown = shutdown, cfg = CFG }

listPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
listPad.Parent = list

local emptyLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
emptyLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
emptyLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
emptyLabel.Text = "No saves yet"
emptyLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
emptyLabel.TextSize = 12
emptyLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
emptyLabel.Parent = list

---------------------------------------------------------------- minimize
local FULL_SIZE = frame.Size
local MINI_SIZE = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 28)
local minimized = false

local minBtn = makeButton(frame, "-", Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20))
minBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 4)
minBtn.TextSize = 16

minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= title and child ~= minBtn then
			child.Visible = not minimized
		end
	end
	frame.Size = minimized and MINI_SIZE or FULL_SIZE
	minBtn.Text = minimized and "+" or "-"
	if not minimized then
		emptyLabel.Visible = (#saves == 0)
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
local function getChar()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hum and root then return char, hum, root end
end

local function addEvent(kind, data)
	table.insert(events, { t = os.clock() - recStart, kind = kind, data = data })
end

local function formatDuration(seconds)
	local m = math.floor(seconds / 60)
	local s = seconds - m * 60
	return ("%d:%04.1f"):format(m, s)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- recording
local inputConns = {}

local startPlaying, stopPlaying -- forward declarations
local addSaveRow

local function stopRecording()
	if not recording then return end
	recording = false
	if recConn then recConn:Disconnect() end
	for _, c in ipairs(inputConns) do c:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(inputConns)

	if #frames < 2 then
		status.Text = "Recording too short"
		return
	end

	-- save it to the list
	local id = nextId
	nextId += 1
	local name = nameBox.Text
	if name:gsub("%s", "") == "" then
		name = "Replay " .. id
	end
	local save = {
		id = id,
		name = name,
		duration = frames[#frames].t,
		loopMode = "off", -- "off", "tp" (instant teleport) or "walk" (smooth return)
		frames = frames,
		events = events,
	}
	table.insert(saves, save)
	addSaveRow(save)
	markDirty()
	nameBox.Text = ""
	status.Text = ("Saved \"%s\" (%s)"):format(save.name, formatDuration(save.duration))
end

local function startRecording()
	if recording or playing or not loadDone then return end
	local _, hum, root = getChar()
	if not root then return end

	frames, events = {}, {}
	lastTool = nil
	recStart = os.clock()
	recording = true
	status.Text = "Recording..."

	-- movement / position sampled every frame
	recConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local char, h, r = getChar()
		if not r then return end
		table.insert(frames, {
			t = os.clock() - recStart,
			cf = r.CFrame,
			move = h.MoveDirection,
			vel = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
			state = h:GetState(),
			-- player stats
			ws = h.WalkSpeed,
			jp = h.JumpPower,
			jh = h.JumpHeight,
			useJP = h.UseJumpPower,
			hip = h.HipHeight,
			slope = h.MaxSlopeAngle,
			grav = workspace.Gravity,
			-- camera
			cam = camera.CFrame,
			fov = camera.FieldOfView,
		})
		-- equipped tool changes
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		local name = tool and tool.Name or nil
		if name ~= lastTool then
			lastTool = name
			addEvent("equip", name)
		end
	end)

	-- jumps
	table.insert(inputConns, UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		addEvent("jump")
	end))

	-- any key / mouse button / touch
	table.insert(inputConns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		local ut = input.UserInputType
		if ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ut == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			addEvent("click", { pos = input.Position, processed = processed })
		elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			addEvent("key", { code = input.KeyCode, down = true })
		end
	end))
	table.insert(inputConns, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			addEvent("key", { code = input.KeyCode, down = false })
		end
	end))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- playback
local controls
do
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return require(player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule")):GetControls()
	end)
	if ok then controls = result end
end

local DRIFT_LIMIT = 3 -- studs before we snap you back onto the recording
local originals = nil -- stats/camera settings to restore after playback

local function captureOriginals(h)
	originals = {
		ws = h.WalkSpeed, jp = h.JumpPower, jh = h.JumpHeight, useJP = h.UseJumpPower,
		hip = h.HipHeight, slope = h.MaxSlopeAngle, grav = workspace.Gravity,
		camType = camera.CameraType, fov = camera.FieldOfView,
	}
end

local function restoreOriginals(h)
	if not originals then return end
	if h then
		h.WalkSpeed = originals.ws
		h.UseJumpPower = originals.useJP
		h.JumpPower = originals.jp
		h.JumpHeight = originals.jh
		h.HipHeight = originals.hip
		h.MaxSlopeAngle = originals.slope
	end
	workspace.Gravity = originals.grav
	camera.CameraType = originals.camType
	camera.FieldOfView = originals.fov
	originals = nil
end

function stopPlaying()
	if not playing then return end
	playing = false
	currentPlayId = nil
	if playConn then playConn:Disconnect() end
	local _, hum = getChar()
	if hum then hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end
	restoreOriginals(hum)
	if controls then controls:Enable() end -- give control back
	status.Text = "Idle"
end

local function applyStats(h, f)
	h.WalkSpeed = f.ws
	h.UseJumpPower = f.useJP
	if f.useJP then h.JumpPower = f.jp else h.JumpHeight = f.jh end
	h.HipHeight = f.hip
	h.MaxSlopeAngle = f.slope
	workspace.Gravity = f.grav
end

local RETURN_TIMEOUT = 15 -- seconds before a stuck "smooth return" teleports instead
local ARRIVE_DIST = 3     -- studs from the start point that counts as "arrived"

function startPlaying(save)
	if recording or playing then return end
	if not save or #save.frames < 2 then
		status.Text = "Nothing recorded yet"
		return
	end
	local _, hum, root = getChar()
	if not root then return end

	local pFrames, pEvents = save.frames, save.events
	local first = pFrames[1]

	playing = true
	currentPlayId = save.id
	if controls then controls:Disable() end -- stops your real input fighting the replay
	captureOriginals(hum)

	local phase = "play" -- "play" or "return"
	local t0, fi, ei
	local loops = 1
	local returnStart = 0

	local function setStatus()
		if save.loopMode ~= "off" then
			status.Text = ('Looping "%s" (#%d)'):format(save.name, loops)
		else
			status.Text = ('Playing "%s"...'):format(save.name)
		end
	end

	-- (re)start the recording from its first frame
	local function beginRun(r)
		r.CFrame = first.cf
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		phase = "play"
		t0 = os.clock()
		fi, ei = 1, 1
		if REPLAY_CAMERA then camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
		setStatus()
	end

	beginRun(root)

	playConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local char, h, r = getChar()
		if not r then stopPlaying() return end

		----------------------------------------------------- SMOOTH RETURN phase
		if phase == "return" then
			applyStats(h, first)
			local toStart = Vector3.new(first.cf.Position.X - r.Position.X, 0, first.cf.Position.Z - r.Position.Z)
			if toStart.Magnitude <= ARRIVE_DIST or os.clock() - returnStart > RETURN_TIMEOUT then
				h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
				loops += 1
				beginRun(r)
			else
				h:Move(toStart.Unit, false) -- real walking, so animations play
			end
			return
		end

		----------------------------------------------------- PLAY phase
		local t = os.clock() - t0

		-- replay events
		while ei <= #pEvents and pEvents[ei].t <= t do
			local e = pEvents[ei]
			if e.kind == "jump" then
				h.Jump = true
			elseif e.kind == "equip" then
				if e.data == nil then
					h:UnequipTools()
				else
					local tool = player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(e.data) or char:FindFirstChild(e.data)
					if tool then h:EquipTool(tool) end
				end
			elseif e.kind == "click" then
				local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
				if tool then tool:Activate() end
			end
			ei += 1
		end

		-- recording finished: stop, or loop depending on the save's loop mode
		if t >= pFrames[#pFrames].t then
			if save.loopMode == "tp" then
				loops += 1
				beginRun(r) -- instant teleport back to the start
			elseif save.loopMode == "walk" then
				phase = "return" -- walk back to the start
				returnStart = os.clock()
				camera.CameraType = originals and originals.camType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
				status.Text = ('Returning to start... "%s"'):format(save.name)
			else
				stopPlaying()
			end
			return
		end

		-- find the two frames around the current time
		while fi < #pFrames - 1 and pFrames[fi + 1].t <= t do fi += 1 end
		local a, b = pFrames[fi], pFrames[fi + 1]
		local alpha = math.clamp((t - a.t) / math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-6), 0, 1)
		local target = a.cf:Lerp(b.cf, alpha)

		-- apply the stats you had at this moment (speed, jump height, etc.)
		applyStats(h, a)

		-- the Humanoid walks for real, so the walk/run/jump/fall animations play
		h:Move(a.move, false)

		-- only correct position if we've drifted too far from the recording
		if (r.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > DRIFT_LIMIT then
			r.CFrame = target
			r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = a.vel:Lerp(b.vel, alpha)
		end

		-- camera
		if REPLAY_CAMERA then
			camera.CFrame = a.cam:Lerp(b.cam, alpha)
			camera.FieldOfView = a.fov + (b.fov - a.fov) * alpha
		end
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- saves list
local function refreshEmpty()
	emptyLabel.Visible = #saves == 0
end

function addSaveRow(save)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Save_" .. save.id
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 32)
	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 46)
	row.LayoutOrder = save.id
	row.Parent = list
	Instance.new("UICorner", row)

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -210, 1, 0)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = save.name
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	nameLabel.TextSize = 11
	nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	nameLabel.Parent = row

	local durLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	durLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 32)
	durLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -202, 0, 0)
	durLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	durLabel.Text = formatDuration(save.duration)
	durLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	durLabel.TextSize = 11
	durLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
	durLabel.Parent = row

	local playRowBtn = makeButton(row, "Play", Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 80), UDim2.fromOffset(38, 24))
	playRowBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0.5, -12)

	local delBtn = makeButton(row, "Delete", Color3.fromRGB(190, 60, 60), UDim2.fromOffset(46, 24))
	delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -12)

	-- loop button: click to cycle Off -> TP (instant teleport) -> Walk (smooth return)
	local loopBtn = makeButton(row, "Loop: Off", Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80), UDim2.fromOffset(64, 24))
	loopBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -118, 0.5, -12)
	loopBtn.TextSize = 10

	local loopStyles = {
		off  = { text = "Loop: Off",  color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80) },
		tp   = { text = "Loop: TP",   color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 110, 200) },
		walk = { text = "Loop: Walk", color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 200) },
	}
	local nextMode = { off = "tp", tp = "walk", walk = "off" }

	loopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		save.loopMode = nextMode[save.loopMode]
		local st = loopStyles[save.loopMode]
		loopBtn.Text = st.text
		loopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = st.color
	end)

	playRowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		startPlaying(save)
	end)

	delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if currentPlayId == save.id then stopPlaying() end
		for i, s in ipairs(saves) do
			if s.id == save.id then
				table.remove(saves, i)
				break
			end
		end
		row:Destroy()
		refreshEmpty()
		markDirty()
	end)

	refreshEmpty()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------- cloud saving
-- Needs the server script (AutoReplayServer) in ServerScriptService.
local SAVE_RATE = 30       -- frames per second kept in the cloud copy
local MAX_JSON = 3500000   -- DataStore limit is ~4MB, keep a margin
local SYNC_EVERY = 1       -- seconds between checks for changes

local saveRemote, loadRemote
local cloudOk = false

local function r(n, d)
	local m = 10 ^ d
	return math.floor(n * m + 0.5) / m
end

local function setIdleStatus(text)
	if not recording and not playing then status.Text = text end
end

local stateByValue = {}
for _, st in ipairs(Enum.HumanoidStateType:GetEnumItems()) do
	stateByValue[st.Value] = st
end

local function packCF(cf)
	local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
	return r(cf.X, 2), r(cf.Y, 2), r(cf.Z, 2), r(rx, 3), r(ry, 3), r(rz, 3)
end

local function encodeEvent(e)
	local o = { t = r(e.t, 3), k = e.kind }
	if e.kind == "key" then
		o.d = { c = e.data.code.Name, dn = e.data.down }
	elseif e.kind == "click" then
		o.d = { x = r(e.data.pos.X, 1), y = r(e.data.pos.Y, 1), p = e.data.processed }
	else
		o.d = e.data
	end
	return o
end

local function decodeEvent(o)
	local data = o.d
	if o.k == "key" then
		local ok, code = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[data.c] end)
		data = { code = ok and code or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown, down = data.dn }
	elseif o.k == "click" then
		data = { pos = Vector3.new(data.x, data.y, 0), processed = data.p }
	end
	return { t = o.t, kind = o.k, data = data }
end

-- turns a save into a small JSON-friendly table
local function encodeSave(sv)
	local out = { id = sv.id, name = sv.name, d = r(sv.duration, 3), f = {}, s = {}, e = {} }
	local lastKept = -1
	local lastStats = nil
	local total = #sv.frames
	for i, fr in ipairs(sv.frames) do
		if i == total or fr.t - lastKept >= 1 / SAVE_RATE then
			lastKept = fr.t
			local idx = #out.f + 1
			local px, py, pz, prx, pry, prz = packCF(fr.cf)
			local cx, cy, cz, crx, cry, crz = packCF(fr.cam)
			out.f[idx] = {
				r(fr.t, 3), px, py, pz, prx, pry, prz,
				r(fr.move.X, 2), r(fr.move.Y, 2), r(fr.move.Z, 2),
				r(fr.vel.X, 1), r(fr.vel.Y, 1), r(fr.vel.Z, 1),
				fr.state.Value,
				cx, cy, cz, crx, cry, crz, r(fr.fov, 1),
			}
			-- stats (speed, jump, gravity...) only stored when they change
			local stats = {
				idx, r(fr.ws, 2), r(fr.jp, 2), r(fr.jh, 2),
				fr.useJP and 1 or 0, r(fr.hip, 2), r(fr.slope, 1), r(fr.grav, 2),
			}
			local changed = lastStats == nil
			if not changed then
				for k = 2, 8 do
					if stats[k] ~= lastStats[k] then changed = true break end
				end
			end
			if changed then
				table.insert(out.s, stats)
				lastStats = stats
			end
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(sv.events) do
		table.insert(out.e, encodeEvent(e))
	end
	return out
end

local function decodeSave(o)
	local fr = {}
	local nextStat = 1
	local cur
	for i, f in ipairs(o.f) do
		while o.s[nextStat] and o.s[nextStat][1] <= i do
			cur = o.s[nextStat]
			nextStat += 1
		end
		fr[i] = {
			t = f[1],
			cf = CFrame.new(f[2], f[3], f[4]) * CFrame.fromOrientation(f[5], f[6], f[7]),
			move = Vector3.new(f[8], f[9], f[10]),
			vel = Vector3.new(f[11], f[12], f[13]),
			state = stateByValue[f[14]] or Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running,
			cam = CFrame.new(f[15], f[16], f[17]) * CFrame.fromOrientation(f[18], f[19], f[20]),
			fov = f[21],
			ws = cur[2], jp = cur[3], jh = cur[4], useJP = cur[5] == 1,
			hip = cur[6], slope = cur[7], grav = cur[8],
		}
	end
	local ev = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(o.e) do
		table.insert(ev, decodeEvent(e))
	end
	return { id = o.id, name = o.name, duration = o.d, frames = fr, events = ev, enc = o }
end

-- checks every second; only sends to the server when something changed
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(SYNC_EVERY)
		if dirty and cloudOk then
			dirty = false
			local list = {}
			for _, sv in ipairs(saves) do
				sv.enc = sv.enc or encodeSave(sv)
				table.insert(list, sv.enc)
			end
			local okEnc, json = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, { v = 1, saves = list })
			if not okEnc then
				warn("[AUTO-REPLAY] couldn't encode saves: " .. tostring(json))
			elseif #json > MAX_JSON then
				setIdleStatus("Too much data to save - delete some saves")
			else
				local okSend, accepted = pcall(function() return saveRemote:InvokeServer(json) end)
				if okSend and accepted then
					setIdleStatus("Saves synced")
				else
					dirty = true -- try again next second
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- load saves from the last visit
loadDone = false
task.spawn(function()
	status.Text = "Loading saves..."
	saveRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AutoReplaySave", 10)
	loadRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AutoReplayLoad", 10)
	if not (saveRemote and loadRemote) then
		status.Text = "Idle (no server script - saves won't persist)"
		loadDone = true
		return
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function() return loadRemote:InvokeServer() end)
	if not ok or result == false then
		status.Text = "Couldn't load cloud saves - not saving"
		loadDone = true
		return
	end

	if type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
		local okDec, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, result)
		if not (okDec and type(data) == "table" and type(data.saves) == "table") then
			status.Text = "Cloud save data unreadable - not saving"
			loadDone = true
			return
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(data.saves) do
			local okS, sv = pcall(decodeSave, o)
			if okS then
				table.insert(saves, sv)
				nextId = math.max(nextId, sv.id + 1)
				addSaveRow(sv)
			else
				warn("[AUTO-REPLAY] skipped a broken save")
			end
		end
	end

	cloudOk = true
	loadDone = true
	status.Text = ("Idle - %d saves loaded"):format(#saves)
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------- buttons
startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startRecording)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	stopRecording()
	stopPlaying()
end)
-- main PLAY button replays the most recent save
playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	startPlaying(saves[#saves])
end)

scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup)
end

local function safeRequire(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)
    if ok then return result end
end

local scripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Gun = safeRequire(scripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun"))
local controllers = scripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local FighterController = safeRequire(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController"))
local DuelController = safeRequire(controllers:FindFirstChild("DuelController"))
local Utility = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Utility"))
if not (Gun and FighterController and Utility) then
    return
end

local State = {
    SilentAim = true,
    AimPart = "Smart",
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOV = 180,
    WallCheck = true,
    StickyTarget = true,
    HitChance = 100,
    MaxHitDistance = 350,
    ESP = true,
}
local lockGrace = 0.18

local Connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function getHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function isAlive(player)
    local humanoid = getHumanoid(player and player.Character)
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getLocalDuel()
    if not DuelController or not DuelController.GetDuel then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, duel = pcall(DuelController.GetDuel, DuelController, LocalPlayer)
    return ok and duel or nil
end
local function isEnemy(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local duel = getLocalDuel()
    if not duel or not duel.GetDueler then
        return false
    end

local SmartParts = {
    "Head",
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "RightUpperArm",
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "RightUpperLeg",

local CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
local function targetParts(character)
    if State.AimPart ~= "Smart" then
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(State.AimPart)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        print("Join Discord https://discord.gg/axonic")

local function getPartMetrics(part)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not part then
        return nil
    end
    local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
    local worldDistance = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    return screenDistance, worldDistance
end
local function bestPartForPlayer(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local bestPart
    local bestPartScore = math.huge
    local bestScreenDistance
    local bestWorldDistance
    for _, part in ipairs(targetParts(character)) do
        local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
        if screenDistance
            and worldDistance <= State.MaxHitDistance
            and screenDistance <= State.FOV
            and visibleFrom(origin, character, part) then
            local priorityPenalty = 0
            if State.AimPart == "Smart" then
                if part.Name == "Head" then
                    priorityPenalty = 0
                elseif part.Name == "UpperTorso" then
                    priorityPenalty = 1.5
                elseif part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    priorityPenalty = 3
                else
                    priorityPenalty = 6
                end
            end
            local partScore = screenDistance + priorityPenalty
            if partScore < bestPartScore then
                bestPartScore = partScore
                bestPart = part
                bestScreenDistance = screenDistance
                bestWorldDistance = worldDistance
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestScreenDistance, bestWorldDistance
end
local function findBestTarget()
    local bestPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) and isAlive(player) then
            local part, screenDistance, worldDistance = bestPartForPlayer(player)
            if part then
                local score = screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.035
                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    bestPlayer = player
                    bestPart = part
                end
            end
        end
    end

end
local function lockedTargetStillValid()
    local player = CurrentTargetPlayer

    if not State.StickyTarget or not player or not part then

    if not player.Parent or not part.Parent or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) then
        return false

    local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
    if not screenDistance then
        return false
    end
    if worldDistance > State.MaxHitDistance or screenDistance > State.FOV * 1.20 then
        return false
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if State.WallCheck and (not Camera or not visibleFrom(Camera.CFrame.Position, player.Character, part)) then

local function acquireTarget(forceFresh)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lockedTargetStillValid() then
        CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
        return CurrentTargetPlayer, CurrentTargetPart
    end
    if (not forceFresh) and CurrentTargetPlayer and State.StickyTarget and lockGrace > 0 then
        if CurrentTargetLostAt == 0 then
            CurrentTargetLostAt = now
            return nil, nil
        end
        if now - CurrentTargetLostAt < lockGrace then
            return nil, nil
        end
    end
    local player, part = findBestTarget()
    CurrentTargetPlayer = player
    CurrentTargetPart = part
    CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
    return player, part
end

local function buildShotPayload(origin, target, part)
    local aimCFrame = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(origin, target))
    return {
        [ShotKey0] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey1] = aimCFrame,

    }

local function writeShotPayload(cameraData, payload)
    if type(cameraData) ~= "table" then
        return payload
    end
    cameraData[ShotKey0] = payload[ShotKey0]
    cameraData[ShotKey1] = payload[ShotKey1]
    cameraData[ShotKey2] = payload[ShotKey2]
    cameraData[ShotKey3] = payload[ShotKey3]
    return cameraData
end
Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
    local results = table.pack(OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...))
    if not self or not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if results[1] ~= true or results[2] ~= "StartShooting" then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if not State.SilentAim or math.random(1, 100) > State.HitChance then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)

    local targetPlayer, part = acquireTarget(true)
    if not targetPlayer or not part or not part.Parent then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    results[3] = writeShotPayload(results[3], buildShotPayload(root.Position, part.Position, part))
    return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end

            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,

            Headers = {

            },
            Body = body

        return "Error: No response from server"

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local function createDropdownOptions()

        optionButton["BorderSizePixel"] = 0
        optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)

        optionButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentAI = option
            G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"]["Text"] = option

        end)
        
        totalHeight = totalHeight + 28
    end

end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then

        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

Section3:Button({

   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)

    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)

-- functions
local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

    if isDragging then

            frameStartPos.Y.Scale, 
            frameStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

   for i = #messages, 1, -1 do

local Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end
