-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]
-- This script is not verified by rscripts.net. Deal with caution.
--
-- Stay safe:
--   • Never log in on unofficial Roblox sites or lookalike domains.
--   • Real Roblox links use roblox.com (check the .com ending).
--   • Treat fake Roblox login / "claim reward" pages as phishing.
-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

-- Настройки задержек (в секундах)
local TELEPORT_DELAY = 0.4  
local SHOT_DELAY = 0.25     
local RESPAWN_INTERVAL = 30 
local BOMB_DANGER_ZONE = 25 
local START_DELAY = 0.5     
local ANTI_AFK_INTERVAL = 300 -- Интервал для Анти-AFK (300 секунд = 5 минут)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser") -- Служба для Анти-AFK
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local isRunning = false
local isDestroyed = false 
local deadDummies = {} 
local currentTargetPart = nil 
local cameraConnection = nil
local inputConnection = nil

-- Функция симуляции кликов
local function pressKey(keyCode)
    if isDestroyed then return end
    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
    task.wait(0.05)
    VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
end

local function equipWeapon()
    pressKey(Enum.KeyCode.Four)
    task.wait(0.3) 
end

local function startCameraTracking()
    if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
    if isDestroyed then return end
    cameraConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isRunning and not isDestroyed and workspace.CurrentCamera and currentTargetPart and currentTargetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, currentTargetPart.Position)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopCameraTracking()
    if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() cameraConnection = nil end
    currentTargetPart = nil
end

local function setupTargetInDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy:IsA("Model") then return end
    local head = dummy:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
    if head and not head:FindFirstChild("AimTargetPoint") then
        local targetAimPart = Instance.new("Part")
        targetAimPart.Name = "AimTargetPoint"
        targetAimPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        targetAimPart.Transparency = 1 
        targetAimPart.CanCollide = false
        targetAimPart.Anchored = false 
        targetAimPart.Position = head.Position
        targetAimPart.Parent = head
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0 = head weld.Part1 = targetAimPart weld.Parent = targetAimPart
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    local dummiesFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Dummies", 10)
    if not dummiesFolder then return end
    for _, dummy in ipairs(dummiesFolder:GetChildren()) do setupTargetInDummy(dummy) end
    dummiesFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if not isDestroyed then task.wait(0.1) setupTargetInDummy(child) end
    end)
end)

local function isZoneSafeFromBombs(targetPos, dummyRoot)
    if not dummyRoot then return false end
    local clientWorld = workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientWorld")
    local testGround = clientWorld and clientWorld:FindFirstChild("TestGround")
    if testGround then
        for _, object in ipairs(testGround:GetChildren()) do
            if object.Name == "barrel_a" and (object:IsA("BasePart") or object:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or object:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")) then
                local barrelPart = object:IsA("BasePart") and object or object:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                if barrelPart then
                    local distanceToTP = (targetPos - barrelPart.Position).Magnitude
                    local distanceToDummy = (dummyRoot.Position - barrelPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if distanceToTP <= BOMB_DANGER_ZONE or distanceToDummy <= BOMB_DANGER_ZONE then return false end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return true 
end

local function isDummyAlive(dummy)
    if deadDummies[dummy] or isDestroyed then return false end
    local head = dummy:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local root = dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head or not root then return false end
    
    local humanoid = dummy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function resetMouseInputs()
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, false, game, 0)
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
end

-- Авто-очистка списка мертвых целей каждую секунду
task.spawn(function()
    while not isDestroyed do
        task.wait(1)
        if isRunning then deadDummies = {} end
    end
end)

-- Авто-нажатие кнопки R раз в 30 секунд
task.spawn(function()
    while not isDestroyed do
        task.wait(1) 
        if isRunning then
            task.wait(RESPAWN_INTERVAL)
            if isRunning and not isDestroyed then
                pressKey(Enum.KeyCode.R)
                deadDummies = {} 
                task.wait(1)     
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ПАРАЛЛЕЛЬНЫЙ ПОТОК: Система АНТИ-AFK (Срабатывает раз в 5 минут, когда включен бот)
task.spawn(function()
    while not isDestroyed do
        task.wait(1)
        if isRunning then
            task.wait(ANTI_AFK_INTERVAL)
            -- Если бот всё еще запущен, отправляем виртуальный прыжок через VirtualUser
            if isRunning and not isDestroyed then
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    -- Метод движка: Нажимает виртуальную кнопку прыжка, обходя AFK-таймер Roblox
                    VirtualUser:CaptureController()
                    VirtualUser:Button1Down(Vector2.new(0, 0)) -- Имитация микро-клика для активности
                    humanoid.Jump = true -- Физический прыжок в игре
                    print("[Mamut Rakhal Hub]: Сработал Анти-AFK прыжок (Прошло 5 минут).")
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Основной цикл зачистки
task.spawn(function()
    while not isDestroyed do
        task.wait(0.1)
        if isRunning and not isDestroyed then
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local dummiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Dummies")
            if rootPart and dummiesFolder then
                local targetedAny = false
                for _, dummy in ipairs(dummiesFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if not isRunning or isDestroyed then break end
                    if dummy:IsA("Model") and dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and dummy:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                        if isDummyAlive(dummy) then
                            local dummyRoot = dummy.HumanoidRootPart
                            local dummyHead = dummy.Head
                            local targetPosition = dummyRoot.Position - (dummyRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 3) + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                            
                            if isZoneSafeFromBombs(targetPosition, dummyRoot) then
                                targetedAny = true
                                local aimPart = dummyHead:FindFirstChild("AimTargetPoint")
                                if aimPart then
                                    currentTargetPart = aimPart
                                    rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition, dummyHead.Position)
                                    startCameraTracking()
                                    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, true, game, 0)
                                    task.wait(TELEPORT_DELAY)
                                    if isRunning and not isDestroyed then
                                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
                                        task.wait(0.05)
                                        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
                                        task.wait(SHOT_DELAY)
                                    end
                                    deadDummies[dummy] = true 
                                    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 1, false, game, 0)
                                    stopCameraTracking()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not targetedAny then deadDummies = {} task.wait(0.2) end
                resetMouseInputs()
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ==================== СОЗДАНИЕ ИНТЕРФЕЙСА (GUI) ====================

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AutofarmMenu"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("AutofarmMenu") then CoreGui.AutofarmMenu:Destroy() end
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 230)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.3, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30) 
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local TopHeader = Instance.new("Frame")
TopHeader.Name = "TopHeader"
TopHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
TopHeader.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) 
TopHeader.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopHeader.Parent = MainFrame

local HeaderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
HeaderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
HeaderCorner.Parent = TopHeader

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Mamut Rakhal Hub I Hyper Realistic Ragdoll" 
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
Title.TextSize = 12
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = TopHeader
local dragToggle, dragStart, startPos
local function updateInput(input)
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
TopHeader.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragToggle = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = MainFrame.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragToggle = false end
end)
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and dragToggle then
updateInput(input)
end
end)
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
ToggleButton.Text = "СТАРТ БОТА"
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.Parent = MainFrame
local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
BtnCorner.Parent = ToggleButton
local UnloadButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
UnloadButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
UnloadButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 95)
UnloadButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 40)
UnloadButton.Text = "ПОЛНАЯ ВЫГРУЗКА"
UnloadButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UnloadButton.TextSize = 14
UnloadButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
UnloadButton.Parent = MainFrame
local UnloadCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UnloadCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
UnloadCorner.Parent = UnloadButton
local KeybindsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
KeybindsLabel.Name = "KeybindsLabel"
KeybindsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 80)
KeybindsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 140)
KeybindsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
KeybindsLabel.Text = "[F1] -> ВКЛ / ВЫКЛ БОТА\n[F2] -> СПРЯТАТЬ МЕНЮ\n[F3] -> УДАЛИТЬ СКРИПТ"
KeybindsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 100)
KeybindsLabel.TextSize = 15
KeybindsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
KeybindsLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
KeybindsLabel.Parent = MainFrame
local function toggleBotState()
isRunning = not isRunning
if isRunning then
deadDummies = {}
LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
task.wait(START_DELAY)
equipWeapon()
else
LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
resetMouseInputs()
stopCameraTracking()
end
if isRunning then
ToggleButton.Text = "БОТ: РАБОТАЕТ"
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 80, 40)
print("[Mamut Rakhal Hub]: Бот АКТИВИРОВАН. Анти-AFK запущен.")
else
ToggleButton.Text = "БОТ: НА ПАУЗЕ"
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
print("[Mamut Rakhal Hub]: Бот НА ПАУЗЕ. Анти-AFK приостановлен.")
end
end
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleBotState)
local function unloadScript()
isDestroyed = true isRunning = false
stopCameraTracking()
LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
if inputConnection then inputConnection:Disconnect() end
local dummiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Dummies")
if dummiesFolder then
for _, dummy in ipairs(dummiesFolder:GetChildren()) do
local head = dummy:FindFirstChild("Head")
local target = head and head:FindFirstChild("AimTargetPoint")
if target then target:Destroy() end
end
end
resetMouseInputs()
ScreenGui:Destroy()
print("[Mamut Rakhal Hub]: Скрипт полностью удален.")
end
UnloadButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(unloadScript)
inputConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
if gameProcessed or isDestroyed then return end
if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
toggleBotState()
elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
ScreenGui.Enabled = not ScreenGui.Enabled
elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F3 then
unloadScript()
end
end)
print("[Mamut Rakhal Hub]: Загружен. Встроенный Анти-AFK (VirtualUser) активен!")

-- Mamut Rakhal Hub
-- Проверяем, не запущен ли скрипт уже, чтобы не дублировать интерфейс
if game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("MamutRakhalHub") then
    game:GetService("CoreGui").MamutRakhalHub:Destroy()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Переменные для подсчета
local totalStudsWalked = 0
local lastPosition = nil

-- Функция для получения текущей позиции персонажа
local function getPosition()
    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            return hrp.Position
        end
    end
    return nil
end

lastPosition = getPosition()

-- Создаем интерфейс в CoreGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "MamutRakhalHub"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- Защита интерфейса от обнаружения античитами
if gethui then screenGui.Parent = gethui() end 

-- Главный контейнер
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 140) -- Немного увеличили высоту под заголовок
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true -- Делает окошко перетаскиваемым
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- Скругление углов
local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame

-- Заголовок ХАБА
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 8)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 32, 240) -- Красивый фиолетовый цвет для бренда
titleLabel.TextSize = 16
titleLabel.Text = "🦣 Mamut Rakhal Hub"
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- Текст с количеством студов
local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
textLabel.TextSize = 18
textLabel.Text = "Пройдено: 0.0 студов"
textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
textLabel.Parent = mainFrame

-- Кнопка Сброса
local resetButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
resetButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 32)
resetButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 90)
resetButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34)
resetButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
resetButton.Text = "Сбросить"
resetButton.TextSize = 14
resetButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
resetButton.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", resetButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Кнопка Выгрузки (Unload)
local unloadButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
unloadButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 95, 0, 32)
unloadButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 90)
unloadButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(192, 57, 43)
unloadButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
unloadButton.Text = "Выгрузить"
unloadButton.TextSize = 14
unloadButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
unloadButton.Parent = mainFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", unloadButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Постоянное обновление в цикле игры
local connection
connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local currentPosition = getPosition()
    if currentPosition and lastPosition then
        -- Считаем дистанцию по плоскости XZ
        local distance = (Vector3.new(currentPosition.X, 0, currentPosition.Z) - Vector3.new(lastPosition.X, 0, lastPosition.Z)).Magnitude
        
        -- Фильтр телепортов / смертей (если прыжок больше 50 студов за кадр — игнорируем)
        if distance < 50 then
            totalStudsWalked = totalStudsWalked + distance
        end
        
        textLabel.Text = string.format("Пройдено: %.1f студов", totalStudsWalked)
    end
    lastPosition = currentPosition
end)

-- Логика сброса
resetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    totalStudsWalked = 0
    lastPosition = getPosition()
    textLabel.Text = "Пройдено: 0.0 студов"
end)

-- Логика выгрузки скрипта
unloadButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)
